notes.subject: wula-werew
notes.rationale: ערב is dusk, evening wolves (KJV, JPS note); some read ערבה as desert wolves, wolves of the desert

notes.subject: kolosi tɛ to sɔgɔma ma
notes.rationale: לא גרמו לבקר: KJV they gnaw not the bones till the morrow, i.e. leave nothing overnight; YLT they have not gnawn the bone in the morning — the verb גרם is literally to bone, to strip bones

notes.subject: were
notes.rationale: Bambara has no everyday word for wolf; were (wild carnivore) carries the picture of a night predator

translation: A ka masakɛw a kɔnɔ ye warabaw ye minnu bɛ gɔngɔ; a ka jusokɛlaw ye wula-werew ye — kolosi tɛ to sɔgɔma ma.
